about: Byte-for-byte copies of the team repository's builders, notebook modules, local scripts and chain scripts, at their original relative paths. Read-only reference: no stage imports src/; every stage carries the code that actually ran (stages/<group>/<id>/). files[].executed_versions lists the versions of each file found in executed copies: 'stage-scan' entries come from an automatic comparison with every executed copy kept under stages/<group>/<id>/original/ (decoded / embedded payloads, base64 / gzip / zlib / zip blobs and pasted cells; full sha256, in-repo location, diff summary); 'citation' entries are hashes read from build documents or CODE_MD5 dictionaries; 'claim' entries have no hash. A stage that ran a file but left no executed copy in stages/ (e.g. a builder-regenerated notebook) has no stage-scan entry, so a missing entry is not proof that this copy ran. See src/README.md.
